scope: Host-only key settings; .env or local file; no browser storage or key retrieval
Automatic localhost access; one-use 5-minute LAN invite in QR/fragment
Title-to-board preparation, clear start steps and bounded microphone wait

tests.note: Layout and mock API UI cases isolate service workers. Dedicated PWA suite exercises real caching. WebKit microphone fixture corrected with an explicit MediaDevices replacement.

realApi.subsequentChanges: Static hidden-file guard and startup message only; no further voice semantics changed.

limitations: Physical LAN phone/tablet QR and certificate trust have not been tested.
In-app browser microphone permission and human speaker audition still require user testing; automated permission refusal/timeout cases use fixtures.
First additional-hint live trial failed on model-selected wrong tool mode; explicit hint tool/schema are now constrained to the recognized request and the follow-up passed.
Initial API fixture and rotation checks hit Service Worker interception; UI fixtures were isolated and real PWA coverage run separately.
A new saved key is validated for format but not billed/tested automatically; API errors surface when voice starts.

distributionRestore.dependencyRestore: fresh npm ci --offline, without reusing node_modules
